NVDA.headline: CEO Jensen Huang resigned over a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy; SEC now probing Nvidia's disclosures
NVDA.summary: Huang resigned on Nov 12 after a board investigation into his relationship with an executive suspected of spying for China; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and the board has ruled out reinstating him despite his offer to return. The WSJ reported on Nov 17 that the SEC opened a civil probe into whether Nvidia's disclosures misled investors, adding to DOJ export-control scrutiny. Huang is due before three House committees on Dec 1.
